H_hierarchical.evidence: The paper defines a flat FSM with X={St,F,R,Sp}; no parent state, nested mode, or composite state is described.

G_guards_arith.evidence: Transition and loop guards include multi-variable arithmetic/boolean conditions such as the parking condition over EA,e1,e2,e3, forward guards W-u3>c and u1>c, and reverse guards A<Amin AND NOT parked.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: Algorithms 5-8 define per-state during actions and updates: v=0, omega=-k1e2; v=vc with omega=+/-k1e; v=-vr with omega=-k1e2; exit updates f1 and f2; stop sets v=0.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: No fault, emergency stop, abort, rollback, or from-any-state recovery path is specified; Sp is reached only after successful parking.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: State and transition tuple are in Section 5.3.1, the parking guard is defined earlier in Section 5.2.1, and per-state guards/actions are in Section 5.3.2 algorithms.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Domain terms such as parking condition and hybrid controller are operationalized by equations and pseudo-code; no outside domain rule must be inferred.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: State actions are mostly co-located with explicit state definitions in Algorithms 5-8 under Details of the States.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: The parking condition combines four threshold comparisons with AND, and the state algorithms add arithmetic comparisons such as W-u3>c and A<Amin.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: There is no composite or parent state, so no parent entry/during/exit behavior exists.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: The FSM has no global fault or recovery transition applying from all states.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: No composite-state initialization or pseudo-state chain is present.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: The FSM has several arithmetic and boolean guards, including the four-part parking conjunction plus forward and reverse threshold guards.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: No cross-cutting rule applies to multiple substates and no parent-level during monitor is declared once for reuse.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Outputs are concrete robot velocity commands rather than abstract effects such as log, publish, or notify.

key_nl_quotes: The FSM has four states and five transitions.
The robot will exit the reverse state when the robot is parked or when the overall size of the parking configuration is less than a predefined value, Amin.
one_line_pitch: A compact but useful guard/action stress test: the FSM is flat, but its transitions depend on multi-variable image-threshold guards and its states encode continuous velocity controllers.
rationale: The paper gives enough concrete FSM material to benchmark guard and action extraction: the controller has explicit transition guards, threshold formulas, and per-state continuous control actions. It is not a top stress-test for hierarchy or recovery because the model is flat and contains no fault-handling path. Baseline difficulty is moderate because some elements are split across sections, but the pseudo-code is relatively explicit.
